opening.argument: The title and description identify page or account deletion as the subject, and the visible sequence follows that instructional purpose. Facebook Pages navigation leads to page management settings and then to the Remove Page section, where the confirmation screen states that deletion is permanent. These are ordinary account-management controls, presented as steps in a tutorial rather than as an offer to the viewer. Nothing in the supplied material shows a promoted payment flow, a promised return, an off-platform destination, or a request for sensitive viewer information. The visible evidence supports an instructional demonstration of how to delete a Facebook page or account, without establishing any separate transaction or solicitation.
